claims.object_text: neuron-specific type-2 membrane protein with a COOH-terminal intramembrane domain and a long proline-rich NH2-terminal cytoplasmic region
claims.quote: PRRT2 is a neuron-specific type-2 membrane protein with a COOH-terminal intramembrane domain and a long proline-rich NH2-terminal cytoplasmic region.

claims.object_text: negatively controls intrinsic excitability by regulating surface membrane localization and biophysical properties of voltage-dependent Na+ channels Nav1.2 and Nav1.6, but not Nav1.1
claims.quote: A large array of experimental data indicates that PRRT2 is a neuron stability gene that negatively controls intrinsic excitability by regulating surface membrane localization and biophysical properties of voltage-dependent Na+ channels Nav1.2 and Nav1.6, but not Nav1.1.

claims.object_text: NH2-terminal cytoplasmic region binds Nav1.2 better than the isolated COOH-terminal intramembrane domain

claims.object_text: COOH-terminal intramembrane domain modulates Na+ current and channel biophysical properties with specificity for Nav1.2 versus Nav1.1
claims.quote: the COOH-terminal intramembrane domain was able to modulate Na+ current and channel biophysical properties, still maintaining the striking specificity for Nav1.2 versus Nav1.1

claims.object_text: dual-domain protein: NH2-terminal cytoplasmic region as binding antenna for Na+ channels; COOH-terminal membrane domain regulates channel exposure and biophysical properties
claims.quote: The results identify PRRT2 as a dual-domain protein in which the NH2-terminal cytoplasmic region acts as a binding antenna for Na+ channels, while the COOH-terminal membrane domain regulates channel exposure on the membrane and its biophysical properties.
